Conclusion A new family of compounds, containing both cyanoguanidine and azole moieties, was synthesized for the first time, by reacting azolium salts with silver dicyanamide. The resulted products were comprehensively characterized by multinuclear NMR, mass spectrometry, FTIR and X-ray crystallography. Also, DFT cal- culations were carried out to study the mechanism of this new transformation, showing essential factors influencing this reaction. The discovered new solid-state reaction could be extended to other heterocyclic ring systems possessing the reaction essentials. Additionally, liquid compound 8 was exhibited good hypergolic performance through droplet test, which stands for a novel type of hypergolic compound. Methods General methods.
